propositions: PR #125 bundles two dependency bumps: zizmor 1.28.0→1.29.0 and mcp 1.29.0→2.0.0; only the zizmor bump should be landed; the mcp 2.0 bump is deferred to ticket 732b due to breaking module removals (mcp.server.fastmcp).
pyproject.toml must be edited to pin zizmor==1.29.0 in the dev group while keeping mcp pinned <2 to retain mcp 1.29.0.
uv.lock must be regenerated exactly via 'uv lock --upgrade-package zizmor' (not hand-edited) and pass 'uv lock --check' validation.
make lint, make typecheck, and the test suite must all exit 0 with no new findings from zizmor 1.29.0 on release.yml.

Gerrit change carrying the zizmor-only diff must merge to main with LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1, and PR #125 must be closed with a comment naming the merged commit and referencing ticket 732b for the deferred mcp work.
